objective: Register a new user who creates a new team and verify they land on the dashboard showing a welcome message
normalizedObjective: register new who creates new team they land dashboard showing welcome message
title: Register new user with new team and verify dashboard welcome
rationale: Exploration showed registration at /auth/register with labeled fields and a Team Name field when not joining an existing team (Join Existing Team switch off by default). Successful registration navigates to /app with headings Dashboard, Welcome {firstName} {lastName}, and ADMIN role. The test generates unique email and team name, completes registration, and asserts URL plus welcome and admin role headings to prove the objective.

previousVersions.reason: Registration still works; the primary submit control’s accessible name changed from "Register" to "Create account", so getByRole('button', { name: 'Register' }) never matched and the click timed out.

objective: Validate REQ-001: Only team administrators may start new discussions
normalizedObjective: validate req-001 only team administrators may start new discussions
title: REQ-001: Only team administrators may start new discussions
locators: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Log in to your account' })
rationale: Creates a team ADMIN via registration with a new team name, then signs out and registers a second user with the Join Existing Team switch enabled and the same team name to represent a USER member. AC-1 opens /app/discussions as that member and asserts the Discussions heading is visible while the Create Discussion control is absent. AC-2 logs back in as the original administrator, opens Discussions, and asserts Create Discussion is visible.
